article.title: Ten years of France insoumise: a Marxist view
article.author: John Mullen
article.content: In February 2026, La France Insoumise (LFI), “France in Revolt”, the largest organisation of the radical left in France, will be ten years old. The post Ten years of France insoumise: a Marxist view appeared first on MR Online .
